operator.job: Integrate member activity and contribution evidence into a BFF without importing quest-engine internals.

object.description: The quest and engagement building for missions, completions, badges, raffles, and contribution artifacts.

question: What has this member completed or contributed inside the community, and which durable artifacts support that claim?
responsibility: Own sealed activity, quest, completion, badge, and raffle contracts plus query surfaces that consumers can compose.

consumers.name: loa-freeside
consumers.need: Typed activity evidence that can be composed with identity and holdings.

consumers.name: freeside-dashboard
consumers.need: Fact-level member contribution and completion context without quest-engine logic in the UI.

trust.note: Sealed protocol types and typed ports define the building boundary; a consuming BFF still owns source freshness and cross-building joins.

owns: Quest, mission, completion, badge, raffle, and contribution artifact semantics.
Typed activity evidence returned to consuming systems.
does_not_own: Canonical member identity or wallet linking.
Conviction scoring, cohort policy, or campaign selection.
The product surface that explains a contribution to a community manager.
boundaries.missing_capability_handoff: Request a typed activity port or protocol addition; do not reconstruct completion semantics in the BFF or dashboard.

flow_moments.contribution: Produce member activity, completion, badge, and contribution facts that support composition and movement receipts.
